Usage Instruction
数据使用说明

MAGICDATA Mandarin Chinese Read Speech Corpus contains 755 hours of Mandarin Chinese spoken speech data, which is divided into training sets of 712.09 hours, development sets of 14.84 hours and testing sets of 28.08 hours. The recorded text of this corpus covers a variety of application scenarios, including interactive question and answer, music search, spoken text message information, home command control and so on. The corpus is recorded by mobile phone, covering various types of Android phones; the recording output is PCM format. 1000 speakers from different accent areas in China participated in the collection. MAGICDATA Mandarin Chinese Read Speech Corpus was developed by Beijing Magic Data Technology Co., Ltd., and the company has full ownership and copyright.
MagicData中文手机录音音频语料库包含755小时的中文普通话朗读语音数据，其中分为训练集712.09小时、开发集14.84小时和测试集28.08小时。本语料库的录制文本覆盖多样化的使用场景，包括互动问答、音乐搜索、口语短信信息、家居命令控制等。采集方式为手机录音，涵盖多种类型的安卓手机；录音输出为PCM格式。1000名来自中国不同口音区域的发言人参与采集。MagicData中文手机录音音频语料库由MagicData有限公司开发，本公司对此拥有完整所有权与著作权。

The user shall observe the following rules when browsing the website and using the data:
使用人在浏览本网站并对数据进行使用时应遵守下列规定：

(1) The user shall use the data in the following cases without payment, but shall attach 'data referenced to Beijing Magic Data Co., Ltd., “http://www.imagicdatatech.com/index.php/home/dataopensource/data_info/id/101”, 05/2019'and must not infringe the company's other rights to the data.
使用人在下列情况下使用数据，不支付报酬，但应当附上‘数据引用于Magic Data Co., Ltd., “http://www.imagicdatatech.com/index.php/home/dataopensource/data_info/id/101”, 05/2019’，并且不得侵犯本公司对该数据所拥有的其他权利。

a. Use data for personal study and research;
为个人学习、研究而使用数据；

b. Use this data to introduce, comment on a work or explain a problem; 
为介绍、评论某一作品或者说明某一问题，适当使用本数据；

c. Report on current affairs, inevitably citation of the data in newspapers, periodicals, radio stations, television stations, etc.
为报道时事新闻，在报纸、期刊、广播电台、电视台等媒体中不可避免地引用该数据；

d. Use this data for school classroom teaching or scientific research, the use of this data for teaching or scientific research personnel;
为学校课堂教学或者科学研究，使用该数据供教学或者科研人员使用；

e. State organizations to use published works to perform official duties within a reasonable range;
国家机关为执行公务在合理范围内使用已经发表的作品；

(2) When using licensed data ,the user shall not use it for commercial purposes, and the user shall not have the right to sell, transfer or publish;
在使用被许可使用的数据时，使用方不得用作商业目的，使用方不拥有销售、转让、出版等的权利；

(3) The user shall use the data as a whole, and may not modify the data content without permission, and may not convert the data format or perform secondary development.
使用方应将该数据作为整体使用，未经许可不得对数据内容进行修改，不得对数据格式进行转换或者进行二次开发。

(4) The company does not undertake to modify certain inconsistencies or defects that may exist in the data provided. The company is not responsible for any consequences caused by the use of the data itself.
本公司不承诺对所提供的数据中可能存在的与现势的某种不一致或者缺陷进行修改。本公司不因该数据本身的瑕疵而对使用方所造成的任何后果承担任何责任。

(5) If the user has exceeded the above restrictions on use, the company will take legal measures to investigate the infringer's responsibility.
使用人若有超出上述使用限制的行为，本公司一经发现，将采取法律手段追究侵权人的责任。

中文手机录音音频语料库
MAGICDATA Mandarin Chinese Read Speech
MAGICDATA Mandarin Chinese Read Speech Corpus was developed by MAGIC DATA Co., Ltd. and freely published for non-commercial use. The corpus consists of 755 hours of scripted read speech data by 1000 native speakers of the Mandarin Chinese spoken in mainland China. In order to accommodate demands of variety, the corpus comprises three subsets: a training set (712.09 hours), a dev set (14.84 hours), and a test set (28.08 hours). All of the three sets are recorded indoor by smart phone and outputs are PCM formatted. The domain of recording texts is diversified, including interactive Q&A, music search, SNS messages, home command and control, etc. 
MagicData中文手机录音音频语料库包含755小时的中文普通话朗读语音数据，其中分为训练集712.09小时、开发集14.84小时和测试集28.08小时。本语料库的录制文本覆盖多样化的使用场景，包括互动问答、音乐搜索、口语短信信息、家居命令控制等。采集方式为手机录音，涵盖多种类型的安卓手机；录音输出为PCM格式。1000名来自中国不同口音区域的发言人参与采集。MagicData中文手机录音音频语料库由MagicData有限公司开发，免费发布供非商业使用。
